'''Vang''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Miraluka/Legends|Miraluka]] [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] who served as a [[Commander/Legends|commander]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire's]] forces during the [[Korriban Incursion]], when the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] invaded the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]]<ref name="TOR" /> in [[3637 BBY]].<ref name="Date" /> during the [[Galactic War]]. Wielding a [[Color/Legends|violet]] [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] and wearing a fanged mask, Vang was one four commanders who led Imperial forces in the [[Valley of the Dark Lords/Legends|Valley of the Dark Lords]], but was [[Death/Legends|slain]] by Republic forces in their advance to the [[Sith Academy (Korriban)|Sith Academy]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Commander Vang appears as one of the four Imperial commanders that must be killed in the Republic version of the Tactical Flashpoint "Korriban Incursion," which was first added to the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel]]'' in Game Update 2.7: Invasion. For Imperial players, Vang is replaced by Commander [[Ceryss]], and the two share many of their game mechanics.<ref name="TOR" />
